history.sg_progress: The Administration notes that the scope of the functions of the United Nations Logistics Base at Brindisi, Italy, and the Regional Service Centre in Entebbe, Uganda, are guided by resolutions of the General Assembly. As such, their reporting line to the Department of Operational Support does not automatically change the scope of their functions. With regard to the financing arrangements for the new management architecture at Headquarters, the Administration will submit a proposal to the Assembly at the second resumed part of its seventy-fourth session to establish a more clear and consistent approach to financing the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support from the support account and the regular budget based on the initial experience gained from the implementation of the “whole-of-the-Secretariat” approach (A/72/492/Add.2, para. 66).
